response.justification: Bogdan has valuable foundational experience in geospatial data systems and distributed systems at scale—including GISCollective development, high-throughput microservices handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby, and demonstrated analytical problem-solving. However, there is a significant gap in modern C++ expertise, with most recent substantial C++ work at National Instruments in 2015. While his learning agility is evident across many technology stacks, for a mid-senior role where C++ is primary and designing critical infrastructure components is essential, the recency gap on the core requirement presents material risk.
strengths: Proven geospatial data systems expertise through GISCollective platform and Green Map applications, directly relevant to routing tile data transformation
Strong distributed systems background with demonstrated experience at scale—microservices handling millions of requests/sec and low-latency data pipelines at Dunnhumby
Clear commitment to problem-solving rigor via testing methodologies, experimentation, and data-driven analysis evident in open-source libraries and workshops
concerns: No significant modern C++ development in 10+ years; primary recent focus (2015–present) is TypeScript/Node.js full-stack roles, representing drift away from systems programming
Lacks domain-specific routing and navigation system experience—geospatial work centers on data collection and mapping, not routing optimization or production navigation guidance
Career trajectory toward web/full-stack engineering raises questions about depth and currency in systems-level programming required for critical pipeline infrastructure
